The strict inequalities in RESULT.md:66 exclude every other class throughout the open interval. A positive maximizing determinant expanded over support vertices is an average of signed determinants ≤ that maximum; two support choices at one corner would give distinct maximizing quadruples sharing three vertices, impossible. For the volume dissections, representative side planes are x+(t−1)y=t for t≤2 and x+y+(t−2)z=t for t≥2; all generators satisfy their halfspace inequalities, and signed permutations give the exterior faces of the respective pyramid unions. This gives 8t and 4t², agreeing at t=2. The fraction decreases to τ and increases thereafter, and the independently recomputed decimals agree. Endpoint equality counts are not asserted. Replay for the finite and decimal checks: python review_evidence/finite_checks.py (section labelled 2); the continuum and rigidity steps are analytic.
